question: How does a piece of text become numbers?
example: Follow the word “cat”. The ID and vector in this example are invented.

nodes.title: Text unit
nodes.body: A token is a unit of text. Here the word “cat” forms one token.

nodes.title: Identifier
nodes.body: An ID is a numeric label. In this table, 42 identifies the token “cat”.

nodes.title: Vector
nodes.body: A vector is an ordered list of numbers. This list is the table entry for ID 42.

takeaway: The ID selects a table entry. That entry supplies the numbers the model uses in its calculations.
limit: Each model has rules for splitting text. The choice of 42 is arbitrary in this example.
